turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: First, inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. Second, check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. Third, inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. 2. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. 3. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. 2. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. 3. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is there physical damage to the encoder strip or read head?

ground_truth.node_text: Physical damage to encoder strip or read head?

turns.utterance: No physical damage observed on either component.

ground_truth.node_text: Physical damage to encoder strip or read head?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the signal quality showing a clean waveform with no dropouts?

ground_truth.node_text: Signal quality: clean waveform, no dropouts?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both channels are producing clean square waves with proper phase separation and no missing pulses.

ground_truth.node_text: Signal quality: clean waveform, no dropouts?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Was the reference mark found during the homing cycle?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference mark found during homing cycle?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the axis decelerated smoothly and came to rest at the reference mark position. The displayed home offset matches the stored parameter value.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference mark found during homing cycle?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I'm seeing positioning errors at several test points that exceed the axis accuracy specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the read head gap to the encoder strip per specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust read head gap to encoder strip per specification

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Read head gap adjustment complete and set to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust read head gap to encoder strip per specification

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the position accuracy after the read head adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify position accuracy after read head adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Position accuracy is now within tolerance across all test points.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify position accuracy after read head adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the thermal compensation coefficient matches the reference value and the model has not been modified since the last calibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cable condition and routing acceptable?

ground_truth.node_text: Cable condition and routing acceptable?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, I found an unsupported cable length that flexes during movement and one strain relief clamp is loose.

ground_truth.node_text: Cable condition and routing acceptable?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reroute the cable and fit strain relief clamps properly.

ground_truth.node_text: Reroute cable and fit strain relief clamps

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Cable has been rerouted with proper support and all strain relief clamps are tight and positioned correctly.

ground_truth.node_text: Reroute cable and fit strain relief clamps

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Did the final five point position verification cycle pass?

ground_truth.node_text: Final 5 point position verification cycle passed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, all five verification points are within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Final 5 point position verification cycle passed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the encoder service data and update the maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log encoder service data and update maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Service data logged and maintenance record updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log encoder service data and update maintenance record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Encoder diagnostic procedure complete. The system is ready to return to service.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
